body:
To start: I have extensive (and I mean EXTENSIVE) first-hand accounts of tripping both 25i and 25c. Both of these chemicals have been my dearest friend these past few months. However, I had never mixed them before.
Dose: 1/2 of 25i and 25c tabs. Approx 600ug each.
Drop Time: 22:30 (10:30pm)
------
Having tripped extensively on these drugs before (solo), I prefer a couple of games of League of Legends during my come up. This is a 5 man team-game, and I usually play with close friends over a VOIP program; Skype. Each game lasts typically 30-50 minutes, and it allows me to gauge where I am on the timescale of the drug.
I keep a trip journal, with times, thoughts, drawings, etc. It helps me keep it together sometimes during the trips.
----
The come up was surprisingly benign for the 25i and 25c series. I had the typical rushing sensations through my body. Only slight twitching through the games. The 25i is most noted for its body high. I felt that slowly spreading through my body as the drug started to take its effect.
~1hour since drop.
----
The second game of League was much more stimulating. Both drugs were synergizing like I had never imagined. The 25i gave me a perfect body high and the 25c gave me an expanded headspace like I had never felt before. I went 15/5/20 that game. It was a good game.
~2hours since drop
----
I had not smoked at all during these games, and I got through the majority of them fine. My headspace was cluttered only a little bit, as come-ups go. Once the games were over, I stepped outside and had my first hit of some green. The visuals kicked into overdrive. Fractals that I had never experienced before, before my eyes rotating in the way that impossible geometry does. The headspace was absolutely perfect, and the body feels were spot on. I had never imagined what they could both be like together.
~3hours since drop
----
For the next 3-4 hours, I did a variety of solo items with my puppy, Ginger. One of the best memories I have of this trip is when I got into the thought-loops really hard. It boiled down to me mentally fighting all of my fears, in my room. A fear of death. A fear, of fear itself. Learning that I never have to truly be afraid of anything. Either it happens, or it doesn't. I have no control over the situations which I'm given. At this point; perspective is my free will.
~4-6hours dropped; significantly peaked
----
The come down was gentle, and I writhed in bed (from the 25i body high sensations. and blankets.) until I passed out. I slept like a baby until 12pm the next morning.
THIS WAS AN UNBELIEVABLY AWESOME TRIP. The 25i body feels synchronized perfectly with the 25c headspace. Literally, the energy work I could do with my hands was UNBELIEVABLE.
For example, if I put both arms out in front of me, and then synchronously move all my joints in my hands, fingers, etc. I can get a mental understanding of what muscles work what. And the small variations from hand to hand, feeling my intricate small muscles. Holy shit. It's fucking incredible.
My visuals literally turned my field of vision inside out at one point. I'm not sure if I broke through the DMT dreamspace into something bigger, or more... something. It was foreign as fuck, and I don't even know how to describe it. Like an inside-out universe. Blehafgiawd.
----
10/10 would trip again.
